author: Veli Raiya
title: Looking for fantasy map designer + character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn't have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you're a fantasy author recommending someone you've personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me. See the next posts for more details on what I'm looking for with each! For character art, I tend to gravitate toward more realistic, epic fantasy concept art, as opposed to a cartoon illustration. My book is on the lighter side of fantasy, but I love art that still feels grounded and lifelike. I'm definitely open to seeing different styles though, so please share your work/recs! Bonus points if you can do POC and a wide variety of ethnicities! For the map, I'd love something detailed and immersive with that classic fantasy-map feel, but I'm pretty open stylistically! It's a very visual world. Portraits for the time being, but if someone can pin down the perfect art style for the series, it'll turn to more! Contact: DM @veliraiyawrites

author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws - Anime / manga style illustrations - Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration - Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork - Semi-realistic illustrations - and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up: Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'm surprised by the amount of people who are interested. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works. Thank you. Contact: comment or DM @blekek.k

author: Kat
title: Paid human artist for short-story illustrations
content: Looking for a human artist for some small, paid illustration work. NO AI ART. No AI tools. I want to pay an actual artist for actual art. I'm writing a series of short stories, and as I finish each one, I'm planning to release them digitally for free. Eventually, they'll all be compiled into a physical book, so I don't need full cover designs for every individual story. What I am looking for is a small black-and-white illustration for each story that gives Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark. Maybe a little less intricate, but I want that I've seen flashes of this in my dreams creepy feeling. Ideally an artist who can gently teach me how much they should be paid for each illustration, because I don't know but I want to do this the right way. If you're an artist who likes to read, even better! I'd like someone who might read the stories or parts of them and create what it made them feel. I have most of one short done now, have 12 total planned. Artist would get credit as the artist/illustrator for publishing. Contact: DM @katinnnky
